description: This file defines an Angular component called 'Column' which inherits from 'DynamicComponent'. It manages layout styling for a flexible column layout, including alignment and distribution options, and renders child components within a styled section.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: An Angular component that renders a layout column with configurable alignment and distribution styles, extending 'DynamicComponent' with properties for layout control.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property for column alignment, defaulting to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property for content distribution within the column, defaulting to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: Computed property that dynamically generates CSS classes based on theme, alignment, and distribution.
